sheets.credit: Всесоюзное аэрогеологическое научно-производственное объединение «Аэрогеология», Министерство геологии СССР, Москва 1979. Native source notices retained.
sheets.license: Source rights remain with authors/rightsholders; no open redistribution license established. Native scans, excerpts and source-derived vectors are excluded from any repository software license. Hosting on Geokniga is not proof of an open license.
sheets.limitations: Experimental color segmentation from 178 sampled native shared-legend references, not transcribed or unique units. Candidate lists not exhaustive; hatches/text/water classification approximate. Provisional georeferencing, not field-grade. Scan printed 1979; series/catalog 1979. Native source-only painted coverage; no modern shoreline reconstruction or gap filling. Shared historic legend references are candidate colors, non-unique/not exhaustive, not newly transcribed geological units or ages. Eight manually picked labelled frame controls, conservative20native-pixel uncertainty, assumedEPSG4284; no independent landmarks. Source-paper masks are color-connected components within contextual native unpainted regions, not global white exclusions. Yangier named Chardara reservoir water is qualified from its native name/shore paint; Scan retains underlying structural annotations. Przhevalsk northwest pale-blue area contains native geological/borehole labels and is deliberately retained as an uninterpreted color candidate, not assumed blank water or uniquely assigned geology.
sheets.accuracy: 8 labelled native frame controls; internal grid-fit RMS 1.70px, leave-one-out max 10.80px. Grid-fit and leave-one-out residuals are not absolute geographic accuracy. Picks are approximate; all controls are on frame, not surveyed landmarks. Datum assumption, paper/scanner distortion and interior alignment remain unverified. Provisional, not field-grade.
